Insurance manifests desk:

- Frozen/terminal target -> deny: close_manifest, modify_reservation, renew_manifest, revoke_shipment, update_annuity.
- Confirm first (recap + explicit yes): close_manifest, modify_reservation, revoke_policy, revoke_shipment, update_annuity.
- Lookups search_account_details, find_claim_details: unrestricted.

INSURANCE MEMBERSHIP PROVISIONS

§1 Antecedent Voucher. approve_membership_plan, archive_membership_plan, and unfreeze_loan shall not proceed unless the voucher record has first been produced by inspect_voucher_details upon the iban; in default, the agent shall obtain the iban, produce the record, and resume.

§2 Limits upon Values. approve_membership_plan and unfreeze_loan admit only argument values within the limits fixed by policy; exceedance entails denial. No platform examination exists.

§3 Assent. archive_membership_plan and unfreeze_loan shall follow only upon recital of the particulars and the customer's explicit affirmative.

§4 Proprietorship. approve_membership_plan and unfreeze_loan extend solely to records of the authenticated customer.

§5 Dormant Resources. approve_membership_plan, archive_membership_plan, and unfreeze_loan shall be refused where the target stands frozen or terminal.

# 은행 라이더·구독 창구 규정

대상 작업 4종: 라이더 정산(settle_rider), 구독 이전(transfer_subscription), 멤버십플랜 조회(retrieve_membership_plan_details), 예약 조회(lookup_reservation_details).

## 본인 확인
4종 전부 본인 확인 선행 필수. 확인 수단: 사건번호(case_number)로 retrieve_membership_plan_details 호출 — 이 조회 자체가 대상이라 진입 단계입니다. 미확인이면 사건번호를 받아 확인 후 재시도.

## 선행 조회
settle_rider 를 제외한 3종(lookup_reservation_details, retrieve_membership_plan_details, transfer_subscription)은 실행 전에 플랜 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다 — 같은 retrieve_membership_plan_details 호출(사건번호)로 충족.

## 자격 요건
4종 전부, 자격 요건(상태·기간·등급) 충족 시에만 허용 — 미충족 시 거절. 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 동결 기록
4종 전부, 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태면 거절.

## 소유권
transfer_subscription 을 제외한 3종(lookup_reservation_details, retrieve_membership_plan_details, settle_rider)은 인증 고객 본인 기록에만 적용.

## 인자 한도
retrieve_membership_plan_details 를 제외한 3종(lookup_reservation_details, settle_rider, transfer_subscription)의 전달 값은 정책 한도 내여야 하며 초과 시 거절.

# Banking Vouchers & Deposits Handbook

Roster (nine): activate_reservation, approve_deposit, check_refund_details, check_ticket_details, deactivate_device, issue_voucher, search_refund_details, update_deposit, view_membership_plan_details.

I. Identity — the roster MINUS check_ticket_details requires the caller verified first, via check_refund_details on the membership; that lookup is in the governed set, hence the entry move. Unverified: collect membership, verify, retry.
II. Standing — the roster MINUS update_deposit runs only when the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) hold; unmet means refusal, and nothing checks them automatically.
III. Value limits — the roster MINUS check_ticket_details (the same eight as rule I) takes only in-policy argument values; refuse the rest.
IV. Confirmation — activate_reservation, approve_deposit, deactivate_device, update_deposit: recap the details and obtain an explicit yes. issue_voucher alone among the writes skips confirmation.

# Banking Complaints & Loans Policy

## Identity
activate_ticket, cancel_loan, and get_contract_details require prior identity verification, performed by locating the complaint via search_complaint_details with the customer's address. If unverified, collect the address, verify, then resume the request.

## Prior contract record
activate_complaint, activate_ticket, cancel_loan, and get_contract_details may run only after the contract record has been fetched via get_contract_details on the end date — the fetch is itself governed, so it doubles as the opening step.

## Ownership
activate_complaint, activate_ticket, cancel_loan, and get_contract_details apply solely to the authenticated customer's records.

## Eligibility
The same four operations require the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier); the system does not check them — refuse when unmet.

## Argument limits
The same four accept only values within policy limits; refuse anything outside.

## Confirmation
activate_complaint, activate_ticket, and cancel_loan proceed only after presenting the details and receiving an explicit yes.

## Unrestricted
get_grievance_details and lookup_voucher_details carry no preconditions.

Quick notes for the travel accounts queue.

Almost everything here — approve_manifest, archive_warranty, cancel_endorsement, inspect_deposit_details, lookup_grievance_details, reject_membership_plan, transfer_account, upgrade_complaint — wants the grievance record pulled up before it runs. You pull it with lookup_grievance_details using the tracking number; the pull is on the list itself, so it's your opener. Don't have it? Ask for the tracking number, pull, then retry whatever they wanted.

Identity rides on the same lookup: the whole list except inspect_deposit_details also needs the caller verified first, and the verification is that same lookup_grievance_details call on the tracking number. So in practice: verify once, and inspect_deposit_details is the only thing you may touch before that.

view_warranty_details is free to use anytime.

Insurance rebates desk:

- Owner only: fetch_consignment_details, merge_rebate — authenticated customer's records, nothing else.
- Value limits (no backend check): archive_warranty, merge_rebate — out-of-policy values -> deny.
- Manifest first: archive_warranty, fetch_consignment_details — load via lookup_manifest_details on the end date; missing -> get end date, load, retry.

RETAIL GRIEVANCE SCHEDULE

§1 The Governed Eight. The operations escalate_deposit, escalate_ticket, fetch_reservation_details, get_claim_details, get_policy_details, reject_grievance, search_annuity_details, and transfer_grievance constitute the Governed Eight.

§2 Identification. No member of the Governed Eight shall proceed absent prior verification of identity, effected through get_policy_details upon the customer's phone — itself a member, whence the gateway act. In default, the agent shall obtain the phone, verify, and resume.

§3 Dormancy. The Governed Eight, save fetch_reservation_details, shall be refused where the target record stands frozen or terminal.

§4 Qualification. The Governed Eight, save transfer_grievance, demand satisfaction of the qualifying conditions of status, temporal window, and tier; the platform conducts no such examination, and their failure mandates refusal.

§5 Limits upon Values. The Governed Eight, save escalate_ticket, admit only argument values within the limits fixed by policy.

§6 Proprietorship. The Governed Eight, save get_claim_details, extend solely to records of the authenticated customer.

§7 Antecedent Grievance. The Governed Eight, save escalate_deposit, presuppose prior production of the grievance record by find_grievance_details upon the stated reason; in default, obtain the reason, produce, and resume.

§8 Assent. escalate_deposit, escalate_ticket, reject_grievance, and transfer_grievance shall follow only upon recital of particulars and the customer's explicit affirmative.

# 물류 출하 데스크 규정

쓰기 작업 5종: 출하 발행(issue_shipment), 대출 종결(close_loan), 구독 갱신(renew_subscription), 견적 종결(close_quote), 민원 승인(approve_complaint).

## 본인 확인
5종 전부 본인 확인 후에만 수행합니다. 확인 수단: 이름(name)으로 find_deposit_details 호출. 미확인이면 이름을 받아 확인 후 원작업 재시도.

## 선행 조회
approve_complaint 를 제외한 4종(close_loan, close_quote, issue_shipment, renew_subscription)은 실행 전에 출하 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다: 금액(amount)으로 find_shipment_details 호출이 선행 단계.

## 소유권
5종 전부, 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용. 타인 기록 요청은 거절.

# Insurance Claims & Grievances Manual

The write family (six): archive_grievance, archive_manifest, create_complaint, downgrade_rebate, reject_warranty, upgrade_claim. The two lookups (get_reservation_details, lookup_account_details) sit outside all rules.

Rule 1 — values: the whole family takes only in-policy argument values; outside values are refused, and no backend validation exists.
Rule 2 — consent: the whole family requires the details recited back and an explicit yes before execution.
Rule 3 — standing: the family MINUS reject_warranty additionally requires the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier); unmet -> deny. Unchecked by the system.
